notes: The box first deletes every lowercase `m` from the original string, then applies a case transform (first character uppercased, all remaining characters lowercased). This explains why `"MOM"` becomes `"Mom"` (no lowercase `m` to delete) while `"mom"` becomes `"O"` (both deleted), and why `"Example123"` loses its `m` to become `"Exaple123"`.
